name: kb_usage
description: Record KB usage telemetry for the cited-based hit rate: { pushed?, cited? }. pushed: ids of entries the engine delivered to a dispatch, each recorded as one returned event. cited: ids of entries a role reported it actually used, each recorded as one cited event. Duplicates within a list count once; an id with no local entry still counts (a bible id from another clone). Append-only: never changes an entry, its use_count or any trust field. kb_stats.usage reads the events back over the last 30 days. A MEMBER session is served it only with the kb_maintainer grant (the engine reports usage; agent sessions do not). Over a remote HTTP KB provider it records nothing and returns supported false. Returns {recorded: {returned, cited}}. Scope: always the calling session's own KB -- a member session uses its registered work folder; any other session uses the first MCP client root (roots/list) inside a git repository with an origin remote, as that repository's top level, or the fleet server's working folder when the client offers no roots; there is no repo/path scope argument (the removed repo_path, repo and repo_remote_url keys fail with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED). Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER, E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO or E-SELF-NO-REMOTE (each with a one-line remediation) when that folder cannot carry a KB identity (it must be a git repository with an origin remote).
